name: Zovo Bank Statement
tagline: Parse and analyze bank statement PDFs into structured data
description: Convert bank statement PDFs into structured transactions with categorization and totals. Hosted remote MCP server (streamable HTTP) with a focused tool set; runs at https://mcp.zovo.one/mcp/bank-statement. A free access token can be minted at https://mcp.zovo.one/mcp/connect and passed as an Authorization: Bearer header for tool calls; listing tools works anonymously. Source: https://github.com/theluckystrike/mcp-servers. Also available on npm as @theluckystrike/mcp-bank-statement.
